description: This Java interface defines the contract for a service responsible for notifying and managing business events within the system, including registering listeners, and controlling external event recording.

classes.name: BusinessEventNotifierService
classes.description: Interface for notifying business events, registering listeners for pre- and post-processing, and managing external event recording.

methods.name: notifyPreBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notify registered listeners before a business event is processed for pre-processing activities.

methods.name: notifyPostBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notify registered listeners after a business event is processed for post-processing activities.

methods.name: addPreBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Register a listener for pre-processing of a specific type of business event.

methods.name: addPostBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Register a listener for post-processing of a specific type of business event.

methods.name: resetEventRecording
methods.description: Reset the external event recording state.
